scores.tell: Drum rims and cymbals are slightly too uniformly glossy, but the soft matte drum heads and metal stands fit the real cards.
The truss and the housing are smooth and satin with fine, clean highlights. It is close to the real cards. The slight dark-metal sheen is a little cooler than the real cards.
The jellyfish is uniformly glossy, translucent and glowing from the rim light. It has no matte area and no fine texture, so it reads as a glassy gel.
Smooth, rounded umbrella panels with soft highlights and a matte-to-satin range. Only the pole is a little over-polished.
The truss is a sharp, detailed metal with many fine specular edges. That is more realistic and more hard-edged than the smooth real cards. The barrel body is plain.
The fabric has a matte weave with fine stitching along the edges. The metal legs have soft highlights. Only the seat is slightly plain.
The air conditioner is a flat, pale, plastic-looking surface with a soft glow. The airflow streaks are hazy and smeared. It has no material variety and looks painted, not modelled.
The saddle leather is satin with stitched seams and a matte seat. The fence wood has only faint, quiet grain. It is close to the saddle with grade 5.
The dish and the base are smooth and satin, with small rivets and a soft sand. The surfaces are slightly uniform and plastic.
Matte rubbery keys with a smooth body and a soft sheen. The finish matches the real cards. The tell is that the pi pattern is flat.
